findings.claim: The README has no screenshot or GIF for the visible dock behavior.
findings.correction: Add a screenshot or GIF to the README that demonstrates dock click-through.
findings.verification: Render the README preview and confirm the screenshot or GIF loads.

findings.claim: g_regionMutationDepth is thread_local but is read on the worker thread, so that copy stays zero and the guard never fires.
findings.correction: Replace the thread_local depth with a process-wide atomic counter shared by the callback threads.
findings.verification: Trigger a region mutation while the worker callback runs and confirm self-generated events are ignored.

findings.claim: DockExitHideTimerProc can remain as a queued TIMERPROC after unload and call unmapped memory.
findings.correction: Use a null TIMERPROC and handle WM_TIMER inside the taskbar subclass instead of a direct callback.
findings.verification: Queue WM_TIMER immediately before unload and confirm the stale timer is harmless with no callback into freed code.

findings.claim: RemoveAllTaskbarSubclasses retries in an unbounded loop, so a hung UI thread can hang unload indefinitely.
findings.correction: Bound subclass removal with a deadline and continue to remove the subclass even if region cleanup fails.
findings.verification: Simulate a hung taskbar UI thread during disable and confirm unload completes by the deadline.

findings.claim: The auto-hide implementation substantially overlaps existing mods and duplicates derived behavior without attribution.
findings.correction: Reduce the scope to click-through only, extend the existing mods for deltas, and credit derived code.
findings.verification: Compare the retained features with the existing mod catalog and verify README attribution and license compatibility.

findings.claim: GeometryWinEventProc handles every location-change event by running EnumWindows and DWM queries back-to-back.
findings.correction: Coalesce policy refreshes behind a one-shot timer or enforce a minimum evaluation interval.
findings.verification: Drag and resize a window while measuring policy evaluation frequency and confirm the interval is bounded.

findings.claim: InstallSubclassHookProc is a hand-rolled reimplementation of SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread.
findings.correction: Use WindhawkUtils SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread and RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread helpers.
findings.verification: Install and remove the subclass cross-thread during unload and confirm no marker or retry loop remains.

findings.claim: CreateProcessInternalW_hook redirects when ExtractUrl is empty, so the clicked link is lost and a blank browser opens.
findings.correction: Fall back to the original call whenever URL extraction fails or returns an empty URL.
findings.verification: Exercise malformed and missing URL forms and confirm the original destination is preserved and opens.

findings.claim: ShellExecuteExW_hook copies fMask with SEE_MASK_IDLIST or SEE_MASK_CLASSNAME, which can make the substituted lpFile be ignored.
findings.correction: Clear SEE_MASK_IDLIST and SEE_MASK_CLASSNAME and null lpIDList and lpClass before substitution.
findings.verification: Run IDLIST and CLASSNAME activation cases and confirm the replacement browser receives the exact URL.

findings.claim: memcpy uses caller-controlled cbSize to write a fixed stack struct, allowing a stack overflow.
findings.correction: Require cbSize to equal sizeof the structure and use a bounded struct assignment copy.
findings.verification: Pass an oversized cbSize and confirm the call passes through with no overflow or stack overwrite.

findings.claim: ExtractUrl and fixed-browser routing overlap pivotlink-browser-router as a near-neighbour Edge-protocol feature.
findings.correction: Extend the existing pivotlink-browser-router mod or document and attribute the exact behavioral delta.
findings.verification: Compare routing options and behavior with the catalog mod and verify the documented relationship.

findings.claim: Wh_ModInit assumes shell32 is loaded, so the ShellExecute hook can be skipped at Outlook startup.
findings.correction: Load shell32 explicitly or install the hook through a late-load LoadLibraryExW path.
findings.verification: Start Outlook before shell32 loads and confirm the ShellExecute hook is installed and redirect works.

findings.claim: g_lvSelectFadeAnims is process-global and mutated by multiple UI threads, racing unordered_map operations and risking heap corruption.
findings.correction: Guard the shared containers with a mutex or isolate the animation state as thread_local.
findings.verification: Drive concurrent selection changes in two windows and confirm no data race or heap corruption occurs.

findings.claim: HdrDarkPaintSubclassProc owns headers in every process and drops alignment, sort indicators, and owner-draw behavior for third-party consumers.
findings.correction: Honor header format, sort, and owner-draw contracts or narrow installation to specific hosts.
findings.verification: Render third-party right-aligned, sorted, and owner-drawn headers and confirm their behavior is preserved.

findings.claim: ListSelectFadeCleanup calls raw RemoveWindowSubclass cross-thread during unload and can leave a dangling callback into unmapped code.
findings.correction: Install and remove the subclass with SetWindowSubclassFromAnyThread and RemoveWindowSubclassFromAnyThread.
findings.verification: Unload from a different UI thread, send the next message, and confirm no callback reaches freed code.

findings.claim: g_progressMarqueeMaskLayer is a global ComPtr shared across render targets and UI threads, causing races, leaks, or a shutdown double-release hang.
findings.correction: Make the layer thread_local, reset it on unload, and use no_destroy for shutdown safety.
findings.verification: Paint from two dialogs, then unload and shut down while confirming no leak, double-release, or hang.

findings.claim: ListSelectFadeResyncWindow starts fades for a select-all of thousands of rows, repeating ancestor walks and map inserts.
findings.correction: Count selection first, skip fades above a threshold, and hoist the invariant ancestor decision.
findings.verification: Use Ctrl+A on thousands of rows and measure latency and retained animation entries.

findings.claim: The WM_DPICHANGED recovery path may be dead because process DPI awareness and message delivery are not verified.
findings.correction: Confirm the executable manifest DPI awareness and retain TaskbarCreated as a reliable fallback.
findings.verification: Test high-DPI startup and Explorer restart and verify the icon size is correctly scaled.

findings.claim: WindowProc can be re-entered on TaskbarCreated while g_trayIcons is being iterated, invalidating iterators and causing use-after-free.
findings.correction: Defer TaskbarCreated refresh work and guard RefreshDevices so it is non-reentrant.
findings.verification: Deliver TaskbarCreated while Shell_NotifyIconW refresh is in flight and confirm no iterator invalidation or use-after-free.

findings.claim: ShellExecuteW launches a bare file name through a search path that begins with the current directory.
findings.correction: Use an absolute SystemRoot System32 path and the default verb for the applet.
findings.verification: Set a hostile current directory and confirm the System32 applet and SndVol targets still launch.

findings.claim: GetTrayIconSize falls back before the taskbar exists and the icon size is never recomputed when the taskbar appears.
findings.correction: Recompute the icon size from TaskbarCreated after the taskbar window becomes available.
findings.verification: Start at high-DPI logon before the taskbar appears and confirm the later icon size is correct.

findings.claim: IsExcluded lowercases every pattern for every device on every refresh.
findings.correction: Precompute and cache lowercase patterns once in LoadSettings.
findings.verification: Refresh with many devices and patterns while measuring allocations and latency.

findings.claim: The x86-64 architecture restriction excludes 32-bit Windows although comparable tool mods omit it.
findings.correction: Remove the unnecessary architecture metadata restriction from the tool mod.
findings.verification: Build and load the tool mod on 32-bit, amd64, and arm64 targets.
